title: HID close falls through into descriptor cleanup
summary: indigo_uni_io.c:2389-2409: POSIX HID close calls hid_close(copy->hid_device), then continues through socket operations and close(copy->fd). indigo_uni_handle declares fd/hid_device in the same union, so these operations use pointer bits as a descriptor. Usually EBADF; a matching descriptor can be closed spuriously. Current wheel_atik/wheel_sx open via indigo_uni_open_hid. Next: Make HID cleanup mutually exclusive from fd/socket cleanup. Verify synthetic tagged-handle dispatch preserves an unrelated descriptor. Correction to early reviewer message: the aliased fd is not necessarily zero; the public union layout disproves that early detail.
